verdict.rationale: Fathom publishes a full public REST API with API-key auth, official TypeScript/Python SDKs, webhooks, and a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.1 spec, and runtime probes confirm the documented endpoints are live and match the docs exactly. This gives AI-native users a fully documented, verifiable way to drive the product programmatically beyond just MCP/chat connectors. Missing for 10: independent third-party developer reviews/case studies of building against the API.
